summary: Phoenix meets core compliance and transparency requirements but requires explicit documentation of model limitations, bias, and evidence blockers to avoid misinterpretation of readiness or approval status.
top_technical_reasons: Commercial readiness output does not explicitly expose model limitations or potential bias, risking overstatement of capability.
Human-review status is reported but not clearly separated from AI-generated proposals in the readiness UI block, creating ambiguity.
Evidence classes and current blockers are not fully exposed to the operator, limiting transparency.
No explicit claim policy or conditions-precedent list is included in commercial_readiness, leaving policy enforcement implicit.

candidate_safety.notes: No production weights changed, no verdict mutated, and no trades created. Safety is maintained by preserving existing quantitative logic and blocking production promotion until evidence and human gates pass.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Explicitly documenting model limitations and potential bias in commercial_readiness will reduce misinterpretation of readiness status.
next_experiments.change: Add a dedicated section in commercial_readiness.py to list model limitations, potential biases, and data constraints.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Operator feedback survey indicating reduced ambiguity in readiness interpretation (target: 90% clarity score).
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Validates whether transparency improvements reduce misinterpretation risks without altering core logic.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Separating AI-generated proposals from human approvals in the readiness UI block will improve clarity for operators.
next_experiments.change: Modify the readiness UI block in app.py to visually distinguish AI-generated content from human-reviewed content.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Operator error rate in interpreting readiness status (target: <5% error rate).
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Measures whether UI changes reduce confusion in readiness assessment.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Exposing evidence classes and current blockers to the operator will improve compliance transparency.
next_experiments.change: Enhance the readiness block in production_readiness.py to display a list of evidence classes and unresolved blockers.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Operator compliance audit pass rate (target: 100% pass rate on evidence visibility checks).
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Ensures operators can verify compliance status independently.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Adding a structured claim policy and conditions-precedent list to commercial_readiness will enforce policy compliance.
next_experiments.change: Implement a structured claim policy and conditions-precedent list in commercial_readiness.py, with explicit rendering in the readiness block.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Policy enforcement audit pass rate (target: 100% pass rate on claim policy checks).
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Validates whether policy enforcement is effective and transparent.

data_or_label_risks.notes: No changes to production weights, verdict logic, or trade creation. Risks are limited to documentation and transparency gaps, which are addressed by the proposed experiments.
